corrections.reason: DOC/OCR typos checked against scanned questions, printed explanations and listening text; punctuation normalized.
Original text typos and mismatched repeated prompts corrected using the audio alignment and companion printed script; audio excludes example, break and advertising sections.

Nine repeated vocabulary records removed from the DOC, preserving the 65-question sequence and four original III passages. Restored I (3) inflection, I (15)/III (31) distractors, V (46)/(50) cloze positions, grammar IV (26)/(40) and V (50) against compendium pp.173-176,188-189.
